apps.title: SirfBazar: Local Shopping
apps.shortDescription: Shop nearby stores, review your basket and follow local deliveries.
apps.fullDescription:
Your nearby bazar, now online.

SirfBazar connects you with participating local shops in Pakistan. Browse everyday essentials, compare available products and place an order with the shops that serve your delivery location.

SHOP FROM NEARBY STORES
Choose your delivery location to discover available shops and products. Browse categories, search for what you need and check the seller, pack size, price and availability before adding to your basket.

BROWSE FIRST, SIGN IN WHEN NEEDED
Explore shops and build your basket as a guest. Sign in with Google or a phone verification code when you need your account, saved addresses or checkout.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Adjust quantities and review your delivery address and final charges before placing an order. Cash on delivery is supported for eligible orders. If a shop proposes a supported change to your order, review it before approving or rejecting it.

FOLLOW EACH SHOP'S DELIVERY
View order progress and delivery details, revisit past orders and contact support. Each shop prepares its own products and manages its own riders, so items from different shops may arrive separately.

MADE FOR YOUR NEIGHBOURHOOD
Save delivery addresses and choose a Light, Dark or device-based appearance. Location access is used with your permission; you can also choose a delivery location manually.

Product selection, stock, opening hours, delivery coverage and charges depend on participating shops. SirfBazar does not own the shops' inventory. Service is available only where participating merchants deliver.

Need help? Contact support@sirfbazar.com or visit https://www.sirfbazar.com.

apps.title: SirfBazar Merchant
apps.shortDescription: Manage your shop's products, orders, riders and earnings in one place.
apps.fullDescription:
Bring your local shop to SirfBazar.

SirfBazar Merchant helps participating shop owners and authorised staff manage their marketplace business from an Android phone. Keep your products, orders and delivery team organised while your shop stays in control of its own inventory and fulfilment.

SET UP YOUR SHOP
Create your shop profile, add a shop photo, choose your category and provide your location and contact details. Set opening hours, closed days and delivery coverage during setup. Marketplace access depends on the account's approval and permissions.

MANAGE PRODUCTS AND STOCK
Browse the shared product catalogue, manage the products your shop sells and update prices, stock quantities and availability. Review incoming orders against your current inventory.

KEEP ORDERS MOVING
View order details, accept eligible orders, update preparation progress and assign an available rider from your shop's team. Customers can follow the saved order status in SirfBazar.

ORGANISE YOUR RIDERS
Manage your shop's rider team and coordinate deliveries through the existing order workflow. SirfBazar merchants fulfil orders using their own riders.

REVIEW EARNINGS
See the earnings and settlement information available to your account. Access is controlled by your shop membership and staff permissions.

GOOGLE OR PHONE SIGN-IN
Sign in with Google or a phone verification code and view the Google account linked to your SirfBazar session.

This app is for shop owners and authorised staff. Customers should use the SirfBazar shopping app; delivery riders should use SirfBazar Rider. Availability and account features depend on approval, role and configured services.

Need help? Contact support@sirfbazar.com or visit https://www.sirfbazar.com.

apps.title: SirfBazar Rider
apps.shortDescription: View assigned deliveries, record pickups and complete your shop's orders.
apps.fullDescription:
Deliver for a shop you know.

SirfBazar Rider gives approved riders a focused way to manage deliveries assigned by their shop. Follow the order from pickup to handover, review delivery details and keep the shop informed of progress.

JOIN YOUR SHOP'S TEAM
Sign in with Google or a phone verification code. Find a participating shop and request to join its delivery team, or access an existing rider account. The shop must approve and activate your account before you can deliver.

SEE YOUR ASSIGNMENTS
View the deliveries assigned to you, including the shop, order status and the customer information needed for the delivery. Riders only receive access to their own authorised assignments.

FOLLOW PICKUP AND HANDOVER
Record shop arrival and pickup through the delivery workflow. Review cash-on-delivery details where applicable, and use the customer's delivery code to confirm a supported handover.

LOCATION DURING ACTIVE DELIVERY
With permission, share your location during an assigned active delivery while the delivery screen is open. This app does not promise continuous background or closed-app tracking.

HISTORY AND HELP
Review your delivery history, report an issue through available support tools and choose a Light, Dark or device-based appearance.

SirfBazar Rider is for riders managed by participating shops. It is not an open job board and does not guarantee work or earnings. Customers should use SirfBazar; shop owners and staff should use SirfBazar Merchant.

Need help? Contact support@sirfbazar.com or visit https://www.sirfbazar.com.
